title: Veiled Sorceress Ritual
description: A hooded pregnant sorceress in a flowing black robe stands barefoot on a dark tiled platform adorned with glowing symbols, constellations, and lotus flowers. She raises her hands in a magical gesture as three ghostly hands emerge from below holding orbs, while dark birds fly around her and a large cracked moon with multiple eyes looms in the starry sky above a swirling cosmic portal.
prompt: A hooded pregnant sorceress in ornate black robes stands centered on a dark platform decorated with glowing constellations, stars, and colorful lotus flowers. She raises her hands emitting magic as three spectral hands rise from the bottom holding glowing orbs. Dark ethereal birds fly in spirals around her. In the background a swirling purple and yellow cosmic portal glows, with a massive cracked moon covered in multiple watching eyes dominating the starry night sky.
